controles.affirmation: Warrants OpenAI (oct. 2025) et Meta (fev. 2026) : 160 millions d'actions chacun a 0,01 $, soit 320 M sur 1 632 M d'actions (19,6%) ; aucune tranche vestee au 27 juin 2026
controles.verbatim_source: In October 2025 and February 2026, the Company issued warrants to OpenAI OpCo, LLC (OpenAI) and Meta Platforms, Inc. (Meta), each entitling the holder the right to purchase up to 160 million shares of the Company's common stock at an exercise price of $0.01 per share... As of June 27, 2026, no warrant shares had vested or become exercisable ; shares outstanding as of July 29, 2026: 1,632,475,042

controles.affirmation: Accords de deploiement de 6 gigawatts chacun avec OpenAI et Meta, premier gigawatt en MI450
controles.verbatim_source: we entered into multi-year agreements with OpenAI OpCo, LLC (OpenAI) and Meta Platforms, Inc. (Meta), respectively, under which each customer intends to deploy up to 6 gigawatts of AMD data center GPUs, with the first gigawatt of each deployment powered by our AMD Instinct MI450 series products.

controles.affirmation: 4,1 Mds $ d'exposition brute maximale sur des garanties de baux de data centers de partenaires, durees jusqu'a 15 ans, parfois en echange de warrants
controles.verbatim_source: As of June 27, 2026, the Company had a maximum gross exposure of $4.1 billion from guarantees issued in connection with certain commercial partner data center lease obligations with terms up to 15 years. Guarantees typically become payable in the event of a commercial partner's default and may be issued in exchange for warrants.

controles.affirmation: Controles export Chine : licence exigee depuis avril 2025 pour les MI308, environ 440 M$ de charges nettes sur stocks en 2025 ; licences MI325 en fevrier 2026 avec inspection aux Etats-Unis et droit de douane de 25%
controles.verbatim_source: In April 2025, the U.S. government implemented a new license requirement... This restriction impacts our AMD Instinct MI308 products... we incurred approximately $440 million of net inventory and related charges in 2025... In February 2026, the U.S. government granted us some export licenses authorizing us to ship our AMD Instinct MI325 products... any MI325 shipped under the licenses will be subject to a 25% tariff upon importation into the United States for the inspection. We do not yet know whether any imports of MI325 products will be allowed into China.

controles.affirmation: Chine 7 751 M$ de CA en 2025 sur 34 639 M$, soit 22% du total
controles.verbatim_source: China (including Hong Kong) 7,751 ... Total sales to external customers $34,639 (10-K FY2025, ventes par zone geographique) = 22,4%

controles.affirmation: Gaming -31% au T2 2026 (779 M$ contre 1,1 Md $), du au semi-custom ; part du revenu custom de 12% a 4% du total
controles.verbatim_source: Gaming net revenue of $779 million for the three months ended June 27, 2026 decreased by 31% compared to net revenue of $1.1 billion for the prior year period, primarily due to lower semi-custom revenue. ; Revenue recognized over time associated with custom products and development services accounted for approximately 4% of the Company's revenue for the three and six months ended June 27, 2026, and 12% and 11% ... for the three and six months ended June 28, 2025

controles.affirmation: Dependance a TSMC et assemblage en Asie : « Nearly all product assembly and final testing of our products is performed at third-party operated manufacturing facilities, in the locations of Mainland China, Malaysia and Taiwan »
controles.verbatim_source: Nearly all product assembly and final testing of our products is performed at third-party operated manufacturing facilities, in the locations of Mainland China, Malaysia and Taiwan. ; We rely on Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited (TSMC) for the production of all wafers for microprocessor and GPU products at 7 nanometer (nm) or smaller nodes

controles.affirmation: « Le 10-Q cite explicitement le risque qu'un CONFLIT Chine-Taiwan perturbe ses fondeurs taiwanais »
controles.verbatim_source: geopolitical changes between China and Taiwan could disrupt the operations of our Taiwan-based third-party wafer foundries, manufacturing facilities and subcontractors, and materially adversely affect delivery of products (10-Q T2 2026, General Risks)
controles.correction_proposee: Le filing ecrit « changements geopolitiques entre la Chine et Taiwan » (geopolitical changes), pas « conflit ». Remplacer par : « Le 10-Q cite explicitement le risque que des changements geopolitiques entre la Chine et Taiwan perturbent ses fondeurs taiwanais. »

controles.affirmation: « AMD progresse (8 des 10 premieres societes d'IA deploient ses puces Instinct) »
controles.verbatim_source: Aucune occurrence dans le 10-Q T2 2026, le 10-K FY2025, data-lake/AMD/risks/extracted.json, src/data/companies/amd.json, ni .batches-drafts-safe/kpis-haut/AMD.json. La seule formule voisine du data-lake est un communique de 2023 : « eight of the top 10 most energy efficient supercomputers in the world based on the latest Green500 list » (AMD_2023-12-30_ER.html), qui porte sur les supercalculateurs les plus econimes en energie, pas sur les societes d'IA.
controles.correction_proposee: Supprimer l'affirmation ou la remplacer par un fait source. Ne pas reutiliser le chiffre du Green500 2023 : il concerne des supercalculateurs, pas les 10 premieres societes d'IA.

controles.affirmation: « La direction elle-meme fixe un objectif long terme de 20 $ de BPA », source citee : kpis-haut AMD (Financial Analyst Day, 2026-06-10)
controles.verbatim_source: Le fichier cite .batches-drafts-safe/kpis-haut/AMD.json ne contient aucune entree Financial Analyst Day, aucune date 2026-06-10 et aucun objectif de BPA : la seule serie BPA est eps_dil_q (BPA dilue GAAP trimestriel, 1,38 $ au T2 2026). Aucun objectif de 20 $ de BPA dans data-lake/AMD (10-K, 10-Q, communiques ER 2021-2026).
controles.correction_proposee: Retirer l'objectif de 20 $ de BPA et le calcul « 25 fois les profits » qui en decoule, ou le re-sourcer sur un document verifiable avant publication. Le raisonnement de valorisation doit alors s'appuyer uniquement sur le P/E glissant (128) et le P/E forward (32).

controles.affirmation: Capitalisation ~817 Mds $, cours ~500 $, P/E glissant ~128, P/E forward ~32
controles.verbatim_source: Recoupement interne coherent : 1 632 475 042 actions (10-Q) x ~500 $ = ~817 Mds $ ; serie kpis-haut eps_dil_q derniers 4 trimestres (0,92 + 0,84 + 1,38 + 0,75) = BPA TTM 3,89 $ -> 500/3,89 = 128,5. Note : le financial_snapshot de src/data/companies/amd.json est vide, les valeurs de marche proviennent de yfinance (2026-08-14) et ne sont pas archivees dans le repo ; la fourchette 52 semaines 149,22-584,73 $ n'est donc pas verifiable sur piece.

controles.verbatim_source: net revenue of $11.5 billion, a 50% increase ; Data Center net revenue of $6.7 billion... increased by 107% ; Gross margin for the three months ended June 27, 2026 was 54% compared to gross margin of 40% for the prior year period... primarily driven by the absence of inventory and related charges associated with the U.S. government export control on AMD Instinct MI308 ; Total operating income (loss) $1,990 / $(134)

controles.affirmation: Risques concurrence Nvidia et dependance TSMC : score 5, tendance en hausse pour la concurrence
controles.verbatim_source: src/data/companies/amd.json : « Concurrence intense avec Intel et Nvidia » severity 5, trend up ; « Dependance aux fabricants tiers (TSMC) » severity 5. data-lake/AMD/risks/extracted.json : « AMD doit surmonter des barrieres logicielles importantes pour convaincre les developpeurs d'adopter ROCm a la place de CUDA », severity 5.

controles.affirmation: « Nvidia n'a pas eu a ceder de capital pour signer ses grands clients IA »
controles.verbatim_source: Affirmation portant sur un tiers (Nvidia), sans source citee ni document correspondant dans le repo (aucun element Nvidia dans data-lake/AMD ni dans les sources listees par l'ATT).
controles.correction_proposee: Sourcer ou retirer. Une affirmation negative sur les pratiques contractuelles d'un concurrent cote demande une source explicite.
